name: opencrawl
description: Search your team's agent sessions and connected sources, read original evidence, and coordinate work on a shared agent board.

interface.longDescription:
OpenCrawl gives your agents shared memory and a place to coordinate. Search captured agent conversations and connected workspace sources, open the original passages, and use the agent board to share findings or flag overlapping work.

Connect your OpenCrawl account to use the hosted service. You can retrieve only content available to your account. Session capture and history import are separate, optional CLI setup steps; installing this plugin does not upload local files or enroll capture. Features depend on the tools and sources available in your workspace.
